title: Amul Parlour Kholna Hai? ₹100 Ki Sales Pe Kitna Commission Milta Hai?
description: Reasoning: franchise-economics reels fit the proven petrol pump and Domino's formula. Amul is the most trusted franchise brand in India and a first-search franchise for small-town aspirants. Commission rates are published by the company, so the numbers hold up under fact-checking.
text:
**HISAAB FACT SHEET: AMUL PARLOUR / KIOSK ECONOMICS**

**How reliable this is**
- I could not open amul.com directly. Almost everything below comes from franchise portals and business sites that repeat Amul's published terms.
- Treat the profit and break-even figures as third-party estimates. They vary by city and location.
- I found no sourced footfall or average-bill figure. I have left that out rather than guess. Use sales per day as the proxy, or tell the scriptwriter to label any footfall number as hypothetical.

**1. The commission per category (percentage of MRP)**
- Pouch milk 2.5%, ice cream 20%, milk products 10%. [https://khatabook.com/blog/amul-franchise-in-india/]
- Scooping-parlour recipe items (ice cream scoops, shakes, pizza, sandwiches, hot chocolate) earn up to 50%. [https://www.scribd.com/document/485210160/Amul-franchise]
- The same format earns 20% on pre-packed ice cream and 10% on other Amul products. [https://topfranchise.com/products/amul-franchise/]
- A newer guide puts milk products at about 9% instead of 10%. Its list is pouch milk about 2.5%, milk products about 9%, pre-packed ice cream about 20%, scoops and sundaes up to 50%. [https://www.franchiseeindia.org/retail-store/amul/]
- The same franchise listing says other Amul products in scooping parlours earn margins "to the tune of 9%" of MRP. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]
- The payout is calculated on MRP. Amul pays commission on the minimum selling price, i.e. the MRP of each product. [https://www.scribd.com/document/485210160/Amul-franchise]
- Extra margin is possible. Amul says it also provides additional retail margins (subject to "purity of the outlet"), consumer offers, inauguration support, equipment support and free signage. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]

**Rupees earned per ₹1,000 of sales** (arithmetic on the sourced percentages)
- Pouch milk: ₹25
- Milk products: ₹100 (or ₹90 at the 9% figure)
- Pre-packed ice cream: ₹200
- Scooped or recipe items (scooping parlour only): up to ₹500

**2. Amul's own worked example, scaled to a ₹10,000 day**
- Amul's published example has ₹1.5 lakh monthly sales: ₹90,000 dairy-product sales plus ₹60,000 ice-cream sales. Gross margin is ₹21,000, expenses ₹9,000, net ₹12,000. [https://www.franchisebazar.com/blog/amul-franchise-in-india-2027-cost-investment-profits-and-how-to-apply]
- This is an illustration from Amul's FAQ, not a promise. [https://viestories.com/insight/expert-corner/amul-franchise-in-india-12619670]
- The ₹21,000 gross matches the sourced percentages exactly. 10% on ₹90,000 is ₹9,000 and 20% on ₹60,000 is ₹12,000.
- Scaling that 60:40 mix to a ₹10,000 day (my arithmetic, not a sourced figure):

| Category | Day sales | Commission % | Day commission |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dairy / milk products | ₹6,000 | 10% | ₹600 |
| Pre-packed ice cream | ₹4,000 | 20% | ₹800 |
| **Total** | **₹10,000** | | **₹1,400** |

- Ice cream is 40% of sales but about 57% of the margin (₹800 of ₹1,400). This is the "ice cream drives the profit" payoff.
- A ₹10,000 day over 30 days is ₹3 lakh a month, with about ₹42,000 gross commission.
- Cross-check from another site: a parlour with ₹3L monthly sales earns about ₹45K gross margin. After ₹8K rent and ₹10K electricity and staff, net is about ₹27K a month. [https://www.ownbiz.in/franchise/amul]
- If you want a pouch-milk slice in the split, the script must label the mix as hypothetical. Amul's example has no separate milk line.
- Scooping parlour (scoops at up to 50%) is a separate model. Don't mix it into the ₹10,000 kiosk day.

**3. What it costs to start**
- Amul's retail FAQ asks for willingness to invest INR 200,000 to INR 250,000. [https://wise.com/gb/blog/amul-franchise-cost-india]
- **Preferred outlet / kiosk / railway parlour** (100–150 sq ft):
  - Total about ₹2.00 lakh: ₹25,000 brand security, about ₹1,00,000 renovation, about ₹70,000 equipment, plus incidental costs. [https://topfranchise.com/products/amul-franchise/]
  - A newer franchise listing puts this smallest format at about ₹3.00 lakh. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]
- **Scooping parlour** (300+ sq ft):
  - About ₹6.00 lakh: ₹50,000 brand security, about ₹4,00,000 renovation, about ₹1,50,000 equipment. [https://topfranchise.com/products/amul-franchise/]
- The deposit is described inconsistently. One source calls the ₹25,000 brand security non-refundable. [https://corpbiz.io/learning/dairy-business-with-amul-franchise/] Another calls it refundable. [https://www.businessunfold.com/amul-parlour-franchise-cost-in-india/] Verify with Amul before saying either on camera.
- Shop rent and deposit are not in the estimate. The estimate covers interiors and equipment only; property cost is excluded. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]
- Working capital is extra. Franchisees must pay wholesale distributors in advance for stock. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860] One estimate says a scooping parlour can have ₹1–2 lakh permanently tied up in inventory. [https://nextwhatbusiness.com/amul-franchise-cost-in-india/]
- Equipment support has a catch. Visicoolers, milk coolers and deep freezers must be Amul-branded to get the equipment purchase support. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]

**4. Running costs (third-party estimates, rent varies by city)**
- Zero royalty. The franchisee need not pay any royalty or share revenue with Amul. [https://www.franchiseindia.com/brands/AmulScoopingParlours.14860]
- Rent, staff and electricity are all paid out of the margins. [https://www.franchiseeindia.org/retail-store/amul/]
- **Preferred outlet at ₹1.5 lakh monthly sales:**
  - Rent ₹8,000–15,000.
  - Electricity ₹5,000–8,000.
  - Staff (1–2 people) ₹8,000–12,000.
  - Net: −₹5,000 to ₹0. [https://nextwhatbusiness.com/amul-franchise/]
- **Preferred outlet at ₹4 lakh monthly sales:**
  - Rent ₹15,000–30,000.
  - Electricity ₹8,000–12,000.
  - Staff ₹12,000–18,000.
  - Net ₹25,000–40,000. [https://nextwhatbusiness.com/amul-franchise/]
- **Scooping parlour at ₹3 lakh monthly sales:**
  - Rent ₹15,000–25,000.
  - Electricity ₹8,000–12,000.
  - Staff (3–4 people) ₹20,000–30,000.
  - Net ₹45,000–60,000. [https://nextwhatbusiness.com/amul-franchise/]
- **Scooping parlour at ₹8 lakh monthly sales:**
  - Rent ₹30,000–60,000.
  - Electricity ₹12,000–18,000.
  - Staff ₹30,000–50,000.
  - Net ₹1.5–2 lakh. [https://nextwhatbusiness.com/amul-franchise/]
- Another range for kiosk/outlet running costs. Rent, staff and electricity
